title: Deltacraft Free Download
description: This is an April Fools version of Deltacraft, a spooky version of the mod
body:
no ai was used in the creation of this mod

this is a _goofy_ version of my other mod, [deltacraft](https://modrinth.com/mod/delta-craft), check out that mod as it's the version this one is "ripping off"

this mod was made as the april fools update to deltacraft, however due to modrinths somewhat long review system it was delayed, use this mod carefully, it could completely ruin the balencing of a world as well as creating ugly obsidian cubes in the sky

happy april fools everyone :)

in serious, the mod is quite simple, find obsidian cubes in the sky, break the heart inside to enter the "dark world"
once inside simply find another obsidian cube and break the heart inside to escape

i'd recomned going in blind, however, heres everything you need to know

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

firstly, the acid rains that occasionally comes is the only time the false hearts can spawn, if stared at for 10 ticks (half a second) they die. this is the only way (other then the railcannon) to kill them. speaking of which, the railcannon is your gift for escaping the "dark world", deals a minimum of 400 damage (I have no idea how much it actually is) to anything in the way along with leaving a crater in it's wake, this can break bedrock, command blocks, anything at all. this can be disabled using a gamerule

</details>
